name: San Luis Obispo Coast

known.via: English Wikipedia "San Luis Obispo Coast AVA"

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Cooler growing seasons than the surrounding regions give higher acidity in the wines.

blurb.text: A cool coastal Central Coast AVA between the Santa Lucia Mountains and the Pacific. Most vineyards lie within six miles of the ocean, with Pinot Noir and Chardonnay commonly grown. Its alternate name is SLO Coast.
